facts.note: Persian army besieges Barca in Libya; months of attacks, walls hold; they tunnel under the wall; a bronze-smith lays a shield inside the wall; dull over solid ground, rings over a tunnel; defenders dig down into the tunnel

jokes.note: 'think the siege has finally cracked him'; '"Lost something?" ... "The enemy's out there, not down there."'

reversal.note: the mocked smith finds the tunnel; the silent army is heard by a shield in the dirt

ridicule.note: the guards think he has cracked; the 'Lost something?' jeer

mechanism_visible.note: shield still over solid earth, shivering and ringing over the tunnel; picks striking below

shootable_share.note: every sentence names a thing: army, walls, smith, shield, guard, camp, corner tower, dust, tunnel, picks

hook_act_on_screen.note: the smith laying his shield face-down in the dirt with the army beyond the wall = frame 0
